## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Explain any skipped checks or tests.
For browser-related changes, include the native runtime/toolchain and integration result.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes regression tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and the changelog are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private corpus data or unrelated generated files are included.
- [ ] Changes to formats, exit codes, dependencies or supported platforms are explained.
